nonblocking_observations.observation: Wrapper accepts a trailing option terminator, then appends defaults after it. Native parser treats appended options as positionals and refuses actual assembly.

limits: Exactly one real readonly preflight subprocess checked fresh site and both installed assets; its returned argv was never passed to main.
Positive/adoption control-flow cases otherwise use injected proofs and do not claim media assembly or approval.
SFX measurement is deliberately outside this actual-film wrapper and uses the native dedicated operation.
Only assembly-guard-recheck.json was written; root code and original independent review were not edited.
